transcript.purpose: What the learner said and the tutor's replies.

label.purpose: Speaker names, error types, states, counts and dates (B612 Mono).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The one enter animation (Now known notice, 200ms).

motion.name: color-hover
motion.purpose: Hover and active colour changes; nothing moves on hover.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action on a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-ink, #e8ebef); color: var(--color-bg, #0e1013); font-family: var(--font-sans, sans-serif); font-weight: 700; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #c9ced5; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e8ebef; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #0e1013; color: #e8ebef; font-weight: 700; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid #23272d; border-radius: 3px; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #8a929d; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e8ebef; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive actions such as Delete everything.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: #0e1013; color: #d64545; font-weight: 700; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(214,69,69,0.6); border-radius: 3px; transition: border-color 150ms, background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { border-color: #d64545; background: rgba(214,69,69,0.1); }

components.name: Talk Button
components.description: Hold to talk; turns amber while held.
components.html: <button class="ds-talk">Hold to talk</button> <button class="ds-talk ds-talk--held">Release to send</button>
components.css: .ds-talk { height: 64px; min-width: 224px; padding: 0 32px; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; background: #e8ebef; color: #0e1013; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-talk:hover { background: #c9ced5; } .ds-talk--held, .ds-talk--held:hover { background: #d99a1e; }

components.name: Interlinear Correction
components.description: Verbatim transcript; slip struck in red, fix set above in green mono.
components.html: yo tieneyo tengo porque la huelga no termina
components.css: .ds-transcript { font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1.6; padding-top: 12px; color: #e8ebef; } .ds-fix { ruby-position: over; ruby-align: center; } .ds-fix s { color: #d64545; text-decoration-color: #d64545; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; } .ds-fix rt { font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace); font-size: 0.7em; color: #2f9e5b; padding-bottom: 0.15em; }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input { background: #0e1013; color: #e8ebef; border: 1px solid #23272d; border-radius: 3px; padding: 8px 12px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8a929d; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #8a929d; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Wordmark plus text links; active link underlined.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 24px; align-items: center; padding: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #23272d; background: #0e1013; color: #e8ebef; } .ds-nav a { color: #8a929d; transition: color 150ms; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: #e8ebef; } .ds-nav a.is-active { color: #e8ebef; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 10px; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; }

narrative.overview: Parrot treats what a learner says the way an editor treats a manuscript: the words are kept exactly as spoken, and every judgement is written onto them, never in place of them. A slip is struck through in red and the correct form is set directly above it, the way a teacher marks a page. The ground is a dark, flat instrument surface; panels are separated by single hairlines, type does the structuring, and colour only appears when something has been judged.
keyCharacteristics: Verbatim transcript with interlinear corrections (red strike below, green fix above).
Dark flat ground, 1px hairlines, no shadows, corners of 2 to 4px.
Words instead of icons; no emoji.
Skeleton placeholders shaped like the content they replace.

rules.name: The Verdict-Only Rule
rules.body: Green, amber and red appear only when something has been judged or is waiting on a judgement. A neutral element never borrows a verdict colour for emphasis.

rules.name: The No-White Rule
rules.body: No surface is pure white. The brightest fill is the off-white ink, and its hover goes darker (#c9ced5), never brighter.

rules.name: The Mono-Means-Data Rule
rules.body: B612 Mono is for numbers, labels, states and timestamps. Sentences people read are always set in B612.

rules.name: The Flat-Ground Rule
rules.body: Nothing is raised. If two things need separating, draw a 1px hairline between them.

dos: Do keep the learner's words verbatim and put every judgement on top of them.
Do use Go Green, Wait Amber and Stop Red only for correct, learning and wrong.
Do label things with words ("Delete", "Hold to talk", "Type your answer instead"), never icons.
Do show loading with grey skeleton blocks shaped like the content (rows, columns, word grid, form).
Do keep hover changes to colour and transitions under 300ms with an ease-out curve.
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients, glass, glows or rounded pill shapes.
Don't use emoji, stock icon sets, unicode symbols as icons, or checkmark bullets.
Don't use a pure white surface or any purple.
Don't use em dashes in interface copy.
Don't set Inter, Geist or Space Grotesk.
Don't add a coloured stripe on the side of a box, or a small label above a heading.
